candidates.decision_relevance: Would materially resolve whether short-term rebounds, multi-day weakness, ETH/BTC deterioration, leverage changes, liquidations, and microstructure reversals occurred in the stated order rather than being asynchronous snapshots.
candidates.metric_name: Timestamped synchronized BTC/ETH/ETHBTC price, funding, open-interest, liquidation, breadth, flow, and microstructure history
candidates.missing_history_problem: Only compact windows and point-in-time comparisons are supplied; actual spans often differ from nominal horizons, 1-hour anchors are missing, and event sequence integrity cannot be audited.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would test whether repeated weak or improving participation observations represent durable cross-sectional change rather than changing-membership top-100 endpoint noise.
candidates.metric_name: Fixed-universe, membership-stable breadth history with constituent returns and universe metadata
candidates.missing_history_problem: Breadth is proxy-only, point-in-time, and uses changing membership hashes; no comparable historical path or constituent-level continuity is available.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would distinguish genuine deleveraging and forced selling from incomplete or directionally ambiguous aggregate liquidation and positioning snapshots.
candidates.metric_name: Venue- and instrument-attributed liquidation, open-interest, funding, and long/short event history
candidates.missing_history_problem: Liquidation totals are lower bounds from fragile coverage, while open-interest changes cannot identify whether longs, shorts, rolls, or venue composition drove the observations.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would test persistence, concentration, sequencing, and price response of ETF demand instead of treating isolated positive or negative settled sessions as contextual support.
candidates.metric_name: Daily settled BTC and ETH ETF flows with fund-level attribution and synchronized price response
candidates.missing_history_problem: The analyses repeatedly contain only one settled session or weekly totals, so persistence, concentration, within-week sequencing, and flow-to-price transmission cannot be evaluated.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would provide the missing external-liquidity and risk-premium context needed to separate crypto-specific deterioration from broader macro moves.
candidates.metric_name: Timestamped macro history for rates, dollar, volatility, and liquidity proxies
candidates.missing_history_problem: Macro fields are absent or unavailable in the relevant captures, preventing temporal comparison with the repeated crypto price, breadth, and leverage episodes.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would determine whether stablecoin supply changes translated into deployable market liquidity or merely represented passive issuance and balance changes.
candidates.metric_name: Stablecoin supply, exchange/chain balances, transfer activity, and deployment-flow history
candidates.missing_history_problem: Only aggregate supply deltas are reported; no comparable deployment, dominance, venue-balance, or flow sequence is available to assess liquidity transmission.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would make the repeated forecast and warning auditability claims testable, including hindsight leakage, broad-range containment, false positives, false negatives, and opportunity cost.
candidates.metric_name: Frozen forecast-candidate and warning ledger with issue times, evidence cutoffs, exact specifications, confidence, maturities, and realized outcomes
candidates.missing_history_problem: The reviews reference three candidates but omit their definitions, freeze times, ranges, confidence, and outcomes; no matured exit-warning rows exist, so precision and calibration cannot be scored.
